service_unit:
[Unit]
Description=Tobkiri PackVM authenticated guest supervisor
After=multi-user.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Group=root
ExecStart=/usr/local/lib/tobkiri-packvm/packvm_guest_runner.py --serve-vsock
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
